preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or control the marketingWallet address
Contract must have accumulated token balance from transaction taxes

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call getAllTaxes() function which swaps all contract token balance for ETH/BNB and transfers it to marketingWallet without any limits. If attacker controls marketingWallet, they receive all accumulated funds. The function bypasses normal tax collection mechanisms and drains all liquidity at once.
